analyst_test: A strong analyst who cleans the release and reads every rule correctly risk-adjusts each assessment centre's genotyping failures on storage time, the LIMS freeze-thaw count, the recorded processing codes, sex and age, finds Kingston furthest above expectation and sends the handling audit there, while Kingston's excess is the warming its buffy coats took from the multi-omics study's rack pulls before the release picked them and Barrie's excess is its own.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each centre's genotyping failure rate read within the structure that damages DNA after collection, each aliquot's cumulative exposure to rack pulls before its own pick (the time-out-of-storage exposure biospecimen science tracks as a pre-analytical variable), which is this task type's own sample-QC object; with another field's nouns the custody log, the freezer map and the call-rate QC lose their meaning and nothing decides.

world.geography: Canada (a fictional Ontario population cohort's seven assessment centres at Thunder Bay, Sudbury, Kingston, London, Windsor, Barrie and Peterborough, and its biorepository)

driver: The decisive quantity is the exposure each case inherits from the handling events of other cases sharing its storage unit before its own retrieval, an order relation between a custody log and a location map that no record attributes to the case, so comparing units on their cases' recorded handling, on how often their storage was touched, or on what happened to each case's own container files the unit whose cases were touched first.
driver_concrete: Every pick from any box pulls the whole rack onto a trolley, so a buffy-coat aliquot carries the warming of every plasma pick the multi-omics study made from its rack before the release picked it; the study swept Kingston's freezers in January and February and the other centres' from June, while the release picked in participant order from February to July, so Kingston's buffy coats were warmed before their pick and Barrie's after, with equal pulls on every rack.
stump: A competent analyst joins the release QC to the manifest and the LIMS, risk-adjusts each centre's failures on storage time, the recorded freeze-thaw count and the processing codes, and sends the audit to Kingston; the step that lands them there is never rebuilding each aliquot's rack pulls before its own pick from the custody log against the freezer map, under which Kingston's excess is storage warming and Barrie fails DNA at about twice the other centres' rate from its own handling.

differentiation.task212: this slot's v1 read each audited parcel's load from the parcels scanned after it into its cage (a sum of later placements' weights in one container, a parcel carrier's hubs, general statistics, which hub, a pdf and an xlsx); v2 reads each buffy-coat aliquot's warming from other projects' trolley pulls of its rack before its own pick (a count of earlier retrievals across boxes no case shares, a biobank's genotyping release, biomedical genomics, where, a pptx and an xlsx); v1 never shipped
differentiation.task181: task181's shared steriliser added risk to the cases its faulty cycles handled, a membership in a resource's state with no order; v2's exposure is ordered per case (only the rack pulls before each aliquot's own pick count) and every rack is pulled equally often, so no membership or share separates the centres
